summary: Tested Reading Streak page and Book Detail metadata features. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering /api/reading-streak (GET), /api/reading-stats (GET), /api/reading-streak/goal (PUT with 1-7 validation, out-of-range 400), /api/reading-session (POST), auth-required 401 checks, and /api/books/{id} shape. Frontend Playwright verified: (a) /reading-streak page renders with header + 3 tabs (Overview / History / Goals), (b) Overview shows Current Streak (2), Longest Streak (2), Total Days (2), Books Read (1), Pages Read (9), Reading Time (16m), weekly progress (2/7 days) with Mon+Tue checkmarks, (c) History tab renders 'Reading History' heading, (d) Goals tab lets user click Edit -> select 5 -> Save; UI updated to '5 days' and toast 'Reading goal updated!' shown, then restored to 7, (e) Achievements grid displays First Steps unlocked and Week Warrior/Bookworm/Dedicated locked, (f) Mobile menu (390x844) shows 'Reading Streak' link with data-testid='mobile-streak-link' which navigates to /reading-streak, (g) desktop nav Streak link with data-testid='nav-streak' present and navigates via /reading-streak. Book Detail metadata block (page_count / file_type / category) rendered code-wise correctly but the sample book (book_873c49aac9ee 'Test Book - Sahih Al-Bukhari') has no page_count/file_type/category values in DB so the badges are (correctly) not shown — this matches agent-to-agent context note. No console/page errors during flow.

issues: Longest Streak card icon (trophy) appears very faint/washed-out against the dark bg on some renders — center card in first screenshot shows almost no trophy icon visible (color contrast). Consider brighter gold gradient or drop-shadow. Minor cosmetic.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Backfill page_count for existing books so the new 'X Pages' metadata badge is visible on Book Detail Page — currently 0/46 books have page_count. Can be done via a one-off script that re-opens each stored PDF with PyMuPDF (same code as /books/{id}/upload-pdf already computes page_count).
OPTIONAL (design): boost contrast of the 'Longest Streak' trophy icon on Overview card — icon color blends into the dark gradient in headless render.

OPTIONAL: ReadingStreakPage.jsx uses useEffect on [token] but fetches /reading-streak and /reading-stats even for guest users if token exists — consider guarding against is_guest to avoid noise (low priority).
critical_code_review_comments: ReadingStreakPage.jsx line 54: PUT /reading-streak/goal uses query-string goal_days — matches backend server.py line 1815 which takes it as a query param. Consistent.
ReadingStreakPage.jsx correctly uses useAuth() and API from '../App'. Good.
server.py /reading-streak calculates goal_progress by counting distinct dates in reading_sessions this week (line 1796-1802) — correct.
server.py /reading-streak/goal (line 1817) validates 1<=goal_days<=7 and returns 400 for out-of-range — verified.

LibraryPage.jsx line 177-187: Streak nav uses <Link to='/reading-streak'> wrapping a <Button data-testid='nav-streak'> — correct. Old ReadingStreakDashboard inline expansion still imported and used as mobile compact widget (line 470) which is fine.
BookDetailPage.jsx lines 934-957: metadata badges properly guarded with `{book.page_count && ...}`, `{book.file_type && ...}`, `{book.category && ...}` — no null-render issues.
BookDetailPage.jsx line 946: color logic `book.file_type === 'pdf' ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-blue-400'` — reasonable, though 'red' for PDF is unusual (traditionally PDF = red is fine).

server.py BookResponse (line 516-534) already includes page_count, category, file_type fields. Legacy books stored without these keys won't have them in response since /books/all returns raw dict from Mongo, not through Pydantic. For consistency, agent could migrate old docs to add file_type default 'pdf'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Reading Streak page all tabs work, goal edit + save works, mobile menu link works, nav link works, book detail metadata block correctly hidden when fields absent)

seed_data_creation: Logged one reading session via POST /api/reading-session for admin against book_873c49aac9ee (pages_read=2, minutes=3). Also toggled reading goal 7 -> 5 -> 7 during Goals-tab test. No new users/books created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reading Streak page at /reading-streak is fully functional — three tabs (Overview/History/Goals) all render, streak stats populate from /api/reading-streak, comprehensive stats from /api/reading-stats, goal update via PUT /api/reading-streak/goal?goal_days=N (1-7). data-testid identifiers: nav-streak (desktop), mobile-streak-link (mobile menu). BookDetailPage displays page_count/file_type/category metadata badges only when those fields exist on the book document — most existing books have NULL/missing values so badges won't appear; this is expected per E1's context note. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_reading_streak_features.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a feature verification (not a bug fix). Feature works end-to-end: FE ↔ BE integration verified via network calls (fetchData in ReadingStreakPage.jsx line 31 calls both endpoints in parallel via Promise.all). Backend endpoints tested via pytest with real JWT-authenticated requests hitting the production preview URL.
